responses.analysis: Yes, it improved. The clearest difference is that the original clear request answered "It checks the cup and reports that it is empty", which invents an observation: no camera image is taken in this mission, so the model cannot know the cup is empty. It also said the robot "starts at the shelf", but the card says it starts at base. My revised request stated the start position, limited the plan to navigate, inspect, report and stop, and said not to guess what the cup contains. The answer became: 1. Navigate to the shelf. 2. Inspect the cup. 3. Report only what is actually observed. 4. Stop. Every step uses a skill on the capability card and the robot never tries to pick up or move the cup, so the plan fits a wheeled robot with a camera and no gripper. It is still only a proposal: the report step has no real observation yet, and the plan names the target but would still need a validator and a fresh image before running. The ambiguous and pick-up examples showed the opposite problem. The model guessed a location for "over there" instead of asking, and for "pick up the cup and carry it" it quietly swapped in a different task without saying the robot cannot carry objects.
